|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 4), the PC website card list text (21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013). It is not the current text. The current text is [[Lars' Protocol Droid (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3): the Master List of 27 April 2013. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB4-69-Lars_Protocol_Droid-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Lars' Protocol Droid]]): Virtual Block 4 release sheet, official text as of 7 December 2009 (slip 69)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found), page 9, slip 69. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf#page=9 Internet Archive]</ref>: “"Device" on Harvest may be treated as "[A New Hope] or [Hoth] droid." While at a farm: your characters present are forfeit +3; may raise this site (if converted) to the top; and, once per move phase, may put hand in Used Pile to place a 'crop' on Reserve Deck.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-69-Lars_Protocol_Droid.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-larsprotocoldroid-pre.gif]]) print it. Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-69-Lars_Protocol_Droid.png]]) prints slip number “69” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): PC website card list, Virtual Block 4 list and Virtual master list, in every archived capture with game text, 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-1240_71">Players Committee website card list (Internet Archive captures): VBlock4Type (Virtual Block 4 list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001437/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 12 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 11 January 2013]; VMasterType (Virtual master list) [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 21 July 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 December 2012], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 11 January 2013]. Later captures carry no game text.</ref>: “"Device" on Harvest may be treated as "[A New Hope] or [Hoth] droid". While at a farm: your characters present are forfeit +3; may raise this site (if converted) to the top; and, once per move phase, may put hand in Used Pile to place a 'crop' on Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' The full stop after “droid” moves outside the closing quote mark (“droid.” becomes “droid”.). The same wording is already in the Players Committee's Holotable card data of 29 May 2010<ref name="cdf-1240_71">[https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/lightside.cdf Holotable card data file, version 29 May 2010] (Players Committee data, copy on GitHub). Card data is dating evidence only, not a card document.</ref>. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes. The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Lars' Protocol Droid (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB4-L-larsprotocoldroid-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual4-Light">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/larsprotocoldroid.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual4-Light) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock4-Light/large/larsprotocoldroid.gif</ref>: “"Device" on Harvest may be treated as "[A New Hope] or [Hoth] droid." While at a farm: your characters present are forfeit +3; may raise this site (if converted) to the top; and, once per move phase, may put hand in Used Pile to place a 'crop' on Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 4 set mark) and prints the number “69” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does; its caption bottom left reads “•K-3P0 (Kay-Threepio) (V)”, the label of another card.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Lars' Protocol Droid (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side p. 10), official text as of 27 April 2013<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=10, page 10. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=10 Internet Archive]</ref>: “"Device" on Harvest may be treated as "[A New Hope] or [Hoth] droid." While at a farm: your characters present are forfeit +3; may raise this site (if converted) to the top; and, once per move phase, may put hand in Used Pile to place a 'crop' on Reserve Deck.” '''What changed:''' the Master List prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image on its page is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1240-71-master.png]]). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number; it shows the whole card top (title bar and lore) with the slip pasted over the lower part; the label under the slip reads “•K-3P0 (Kay-Threepio) (V)”, the label of another card.
